rules.requirement: Each night*, you learn which character died by execution today.

assertingTests.name: Undertaker learns an execution death, not a night death (TB-UNDERTAKER-01)
the Undertaker step is built after an execution death with the character shape (TB-UNDERTAKER-01, SYS-NIGHT-02)
the Undertaker reads the execution of the day that just ended (TB-UNDERTAKER-01)
the Undertaker step keeps the executed character as its record and writes one step line (TB-UNDERTAKER-01)
a healthy Undertaker step stores what the host sends and journals it as a registration choice (TB-UNDERTAKER-01)
an executed Recluse may be shown to the Undertaker as a Minion or the Demon (TB-UNDERTAKER-01, TB-RECLUSE-01)
an executed Spy may be shown to the Undertaker as a Townsfolk or an Outsider (TB-UNDERTAKER-01, TB-SPY-01)
an executed Drunk is shown to the Undertaker as the Drunk (TB-UNDERTAKER-01, TB-DRUNK-01)
an Undertaker step without an execution death on record stores the note that there was none (TB-UNDERTAKER-01)
the Undertaker step previews, applies and replays with the command clock and ids (TB-UNDERTAKER-01)
the Undertaker module declares the character shape and keeps its wake (TB-UNDERTAKER-01)
the Undertaker learns the character that died by execution today (TB-UNDERTAKER-01)
the Undertaker names every character the executed player may register as (TB-UNDERTAKER-01)
the Undertaker reads the character recorded at the death (TB-UNDERTAKER-01)
without an execution death the Undertaker has a note and no answer (TB-UNDERTAKER-01)
